gaps.sentence: She was ___ the impression that the interview was today.
gaps.explanation: 'Under the impression that …' = believing, perhaps wrongly.

gaps.sentence: She denied ___ the last piece of cake.
By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather not ___ about it over the phone.
There were so ___ complaints that the scheme was dropped.
___ of the two passwords works — try the other one.
gaps.hint: not one and not the other
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of the two' = not either of them.

gaps.sentence: The demonstrators were ___ from entering the building.
gaps.explanation: 'prevent somebody FROM doing' — passive: were prevented from entering.

gaps.sentence: You needn't ___ worried — everything is fine.
